$description: Table V2 Component Contract. This file defines structure, capabilities and runtime semantics; it is not a Token Recipe.

designSource.legacyVisualBaselineStatus: historical-only; recover from Git if needed, not a build input

sharedBindings.rule: Table maps shared dimensions; it does not duplicate primitive values.

rules: each leaf header binds exactly one unique columnId
each data column appears exactly once in the header tree
a group header contains only group or leaf children
header column order matches body column order
group headers do not receive sort or filter interactions by default
colSpan is derived from the number of leaf columns in the subtree
rowSpan is derived from the maximum header tree depth
row-selection, row-index, row-actions and other utility columns are represented as header leaves

compositionRules: display type and editor type are independent and may coexist
row-selection checkbox is distinct from a business boolean editor
header selection control and row selection control share Checkbox visuals but have different semantics
header select-all is rendered only for multiple row selection
header select-all state is calculated from eligible rows within the declared scope
ineligible rows are excluded from select-all counts and do not become selected
header select-all changes the row selection set only and never edits business fields
body cell spans are explicitly declared by Runtime API and are not inferred from content type
a spanned body region has one owner cell and occupied cells are not independently rendered
body cell spans require compatibility validation with sorting filtering pagination virtualization and editing
a composite cell is an internal cell structure and does not imply rowSpan or colSpan
display layout and editor group remain independent
composite editor fields, group validation and group commit are declared by Runtime API
table owns cell layout spacing and slots while nested editors retain their own component Tokens
table data lifecycle states are distinct from row-level business data status
loading empty no-match and error are structural table states
data lifecycle transitions retry and data-source errors are Runtime API owned
loading empty no-match and error replace the body region through dedicated structural slots
header remains visible when the column schema is known unless Runtime explicitly overrides it
sort and filter are header actions with dedicated slots
header action extensions are registered by Runtime API and do not require new Table visual axes
custom header actions must declare target slot availability and event behavior
column width policy resize reorder and visibility are Runtime API owned
column layout changes preserve header body frozen-column and editor alignment
utility columns may use fixed widths while data columns may use auto minmax or flex
pagination and virtualization are data-window capabilities owned by Runtime API
selection focus and draft state are keyed by stable recordId rather than row index
data-window changes must preserve the table visual contract for header columns frozen columns and editors
data refresh may be manual polling or push-driven and is Runtime API owned
refresh reconciliation keys selection focus and drafts by stable recordId
external data refresh must not silently overwrite uncommitted drafts
validation scope and commit scope are independent
row scope validates or commits the declared fields of one record
column scope validates or commits one field across an explicitly declared record set
cell edit-group row column and table scopes are Runtime API capabilities
keyboard focus and navigation are Runtime API owned
opened overlays receive keyboard events before nested editors cells and rows
nested editors receive keyboard events before cell and row handlers
tab-sequence and grid-navigation are distinct interaction modes
IME candidate confirmation must not trigger table commit
overflow presentation reuses the shared Tooltip or Popover component
overflow content is provided by the Table cell through a content slot
single-line and multi-line overflow presentation share the complete source content
overflow placement and size constraints are Runtime API owned and do not change row height
row hover column hover and cell selection are independent overlays
hovering a cell may activate row and column overlays simultaneously
cell selection is not cleared by pointer hover
hover overlays provide visual feedback and do not directly execute business actions
actions declare an explicit target scope and slot
column actions are carried by header action slots and do not arise from column hover
row actions target one stable record while selection actions target the selected record set
column schema identity is a stable column id
column field binding display editor formatter and slots are Runtime API owned
display type editor type and content layout are independent column properties
cell content cell editor and cell action are separate structural slots
action visibility and enabled state are runtime evaluated independently
disabled actions may expose a disabled reason without becoming interactive
action execution states are idle pending success and failed
pending locks the declared action target and failed preserves data and drafts
table scrollbars reuse the shared scroll-bar component and never duplicate scrollbar Tokens
scrollbar visibility policy and content scroll ownership are Runtime API owned
sorting and filtering are independent header actions
sorting targets leaf data columns and compares underlying values
table filtering and editor candidate search are independent query scopes
structural lifecycle states replace the body before ordinary overlays are resolved
data-status.error has highest semantic visual priority over availability selection hover and base
background and border overlays use property-specific resolution order
table selection, cell selection, keyboard focus and editing session are independent records
opened overlay receives the event before nested control, cell, and row handlers
sorting and filtering operate on underlying values rather than formatted display strings
drafts are keyed by stable record id and field or edit-group id
loading and empty are structural states and do not become row interaction states

runtimeOwns: freeze rows and columns, including scroll synchronization and frozen-boundary rendering
body cell span declarations and their compatibility validation
